name: Virus
source:
Medical student Satou Masaki was separated from his big brother, Kagura Kyouichi and his little sister, Kagura Mika, due to their parent’s divorce. 

A few years later Mika, who he has started talking to via the internet, asks him to check on their brother, who has stopped responding to her messages. When Masaki arrives at Kyouichi’s apartment he discovers his brother’s dead body covered with tattoos- four kinds of symbols and two spirals. 

Misaki starts to investigate his brother’s death along with Houjou Ritsuko, his lover who is also a police detective, and his friend Suzuhara Natsune. As they get closer to figuring it out they encounter an onslaught of mystery and death. 

What truth is waiting to be revealed to them?!

 [Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=9195]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
医学生佐藤正树因父母离婚而与哥哥神乐恭一和妹妹神乐美嘉失散。

几年后，他开始通过互联网与米卡交谈，米卡让他检查一下他们的兄弟，因为他已经不再回复她的信息了。当正树到达恭一的公寓时，他发现哥哥的尸体上布满了纹身——四种符号和两个螺旋。

美咲与身为警探的恋人北条律子以及朋友铃原夏音一起开始调查哥哥的死因。当他们越来越接近弄清楚这一点时，他们遇到了神秘和死亡的袭击。

到底什么真相等待着他们揭晓？！

 [摘要翻译自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=9195]Getchu.com[/url]]
